archetypes.name: review-split-import-surface
archetypes.rationale: Verify that the thin shim re-exports match what the callers actually depend on
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that review_pipeline.py re-exports all symbols accessed by review_and_fix.py, plan_review_panel.py, plan_review_round.py, test_external_dispatch.py and the CLI entry table in larch/cli.py. Verify no callers import from the old monolithic file in a way that now silently shadows a sub-module symbol. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
